visual_systems_considered.name: Venue As Familiar Ritual
visual_systems_considered.reason: Pizza Bakery appears as the recurring place, but the couple's behavior remains primary.

visual_systems_considered.name: Menu Comedy Poster
visual_systems_considered.reason: Too text-led and not enough staged relationship behavior.

rejected_motifs: giant Pizza Bakery logo dominating slides
full food close-up without faces or hands
menu text as readable design element
typography_plan: Exact handwritten copy in upper-middle warm ivory negative space. Do not place text over faces, hands, menu, pizza, coffee, or any venue cue.
aspect_plan: For 4:5, keep the couple and table lower/middle-lower with clean text space above. For 9:16, use more ceiling/wall/ivory paper above and keep story action in lower half.
dop_lock: Do not illustrate a restaurant. Film a ritual. Each slide gets one visual verb, and the menu should gradually lose visual power across the set.
